Accomplishment
1. Founder and President of Taiwanese-American Religious Study Association, Southern California (TARSA-SC)(台美人宗教研習會創立會長) 2009-present

2. Co-founder, One of the First Elders, and the First Choir Director of Formosan Presbyterian Church in Los Angeles 1971-1974

3. First Recipient, “Society of Perinatal Obstetricians Achievement Award” for the Individual Who Has Contributed Significantly to the Society and Its Mission, by the Society of Perinatal Obstetricians, 1994

4. Chairman Emeritus, Dept. of OB/GYN of Albert Einstein Medical Center, Philadelphia, PA, Life Time Honor Given in 2002

5. Honorary Professor, Dept. of OB/GYN of Thomas Jefferson University, Jefferson Medical College, Philadelphia, PA, Life Time Honor Given in 2002

6. Involvement in Society of Perinatal Obstetricians (later renamed: Society of Maternal-Fetal Medicine)

7. Involvement in North American Taiwanese Medical Association

8. Outstanding Taiwanese American Elected by T.A. Archives in 08/2018

Publication(Non-professional)
1.「愛的交響樂」，1965（翻譯自Glaudo Pellegrini著“Sinfonia d’Amore”）

2. Proceedings of the Conference“Say Yes to Life! Searching for the Meaning of Life（向生命說 Yes! 尋求生命的意義）” (2015) (Editor)

Hobby
Classical music, Movies, Photography, Reading, Computer applications
